response.sql: WITH race_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_totals) SELECT SUM(rt.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(rt.avg_laps) AS avg_laps, AVG(rt.total_points - b.avg_total) AS avg_excess_points FROM race_totals AS rt CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE rt.total_points > b.avg_total
